SELECT ppd.id, ppd.create_user_id, ppd.create_user_name, ppd.create_time, ppd.update_user_id, ppd.update_user_name, ppd.update_time, ppd.version, ppd.is_deleted, ppd.sku_id, ppd.purchase_price_id, ppd.sku_no, ppd.product_name, ppd.min_qty, ppd.max_qty, ppd.currency, ppd.tax_price, ppd.expire_date, ppd.tax_rate, ppd.delivery_day, ppd.effective_date, ppd.disabled, ppd.kingdee_detail_id, ppd.remark, pp.supplier_id, pp.code AS priceCode, pp.purchase_org_name FROM purchase_price_detail ppd inner join purchase_price pp on pp.id = ppd.purchase_price_id WHERE ppd.is_deleted=FALSE AND pp.is_deleted=FALSE
AND pp.id IN
#{purchasePriceId}
and pp.code ILIKE concat('%',#{params.priceCode}::text,'%')
